title: AFTERIMAGE//PULSE (full length): Living Bass and Impossible Voice

sections.development: V2: the hook dark and close; the music box behind it; kick and bass from bar 3.
V2: 2-step; the bass answers each held note, then pulls in dotted eighths and realigns.
C#m A F#m G#7: the bass leads with the reply; the synth answers with single pulse pairs; the voice takes two notes of each riff; breakdown and a stop on the pulse.
The hook over the reply in C# minor.
One melody passed between voice, bass, talking drum and log; convergence; silence; the cry.
V2 note for note: the hook at half speed in the choir; the sink into C major; the bloom.
C turns to E; the reply as a hymn in canon (altos, sopranos, music box); the glitch chords become the cadence.
The heartbeat quickens into the groove; the reply as an E major bass riff; the synth answers.
Hook over reply; the swap; the choir catches up through the cascade; the deceptive landing on C; C D E; the last groove; the bass break; the first pulse pair.
The music box alone: the opening image, the reply, the resolving pair.
